cues.text: Which arterial blood gas result do thiazide diuretics give?
Thiazide diuretics inhibit the sodium-chloride transporter in the distal tubule.
With diuretics, increased hydrogen and potassium ion loss can lead to metabolic alkalosis.
Metabolic alkalosis is an increased pH in the tissues.
It comes from a decreased hydrogen ion concentration, or directly from increased bicarbonate.
So the answer is metabolic alkalosis.
